method: Native spline silhouettes traced from the original; manually reconstructed clipped cubic fold boundaries; source-fitted 11-stop linear gradients. No generative image tool and no embedded PNG.

tools.gradient_fitting: NumPy least squares; independent linear axis per visible face

fidelity_limit: PNG does not contain original vector geometry. Curves and gradients are reconstructed, not a mathematically lossless recovery of the raster. Smooth vector fills intentionally omit raster noise and faint stray alpha pixels.
